jobs.description: Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible position for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Practical training with an experienced buddy. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop and become a buddy for new colleagues. A varied role combining driving, customer service and physical activity. Opportunities for long-term employment through Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Almere, you take online grocery orders on the final part of their journey: from the delivery location to the customer's front door. At the beginning of your shift, you collect the keys to your delivery van and check the route prepared for you. Once you are ready, you head out to your first address. Navigation guides you between customers in Almere and the surrounding area. At each stop, you select the correct order from the van and check it with a handheld scanner. You then carry the grocery crates to the customer's door. You make sure every order is handed over in a friendly and professional way. If a payment needs to be processed, you take care of it. Empty crates and returnable packaging can also be collected before you leave. Then it is time for your next delivery. You will spend plenty of time behind the wheel, but this is not a job where you sit down all day. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and carrying grocery crates are all part of a normal shift. Once your final order has been delivered, you return to the Almere location. You complete the route, return your equipment and leave the van ready for its next shift. Do I need previous experience? No. Previous experience as acourier or delivery driver is not required. An experienced buddy will train you during your first working days. You will learn how to use the van, scanner and delivery systems and how to handle different situations at the customer's door. How flexible are the working hours? You can submit your availability and work between 12 and 32 hours per week. Deliveries take place from Monday through Sunday, with shifts available at different times of the day. You need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. Is this an active job? Yes. Driving is only one part of the role. Throughout your shift, you regularly get in and out of the van and carry grocery crates to customers. You should therefore be comfortable with physical activity while working. Are there opportunities to develop? Yes. After gaining experience, you may have the opportunity to become a buddy. In this role, you help new delivery drivers during their first working days. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere You are at least 18 years old. You have a valid category B driving licence. You speak Dutch and/or English. You are available for at least two shifts per week. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. You are friendly and helpful towards customers. You are comfortable working independently. You drive safely and responsibly. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. Ready for a job that keeps you moving? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Almere. Questions about the position?
